populationServed.rationale: UIDAI is a national authority with Head Office and eight Regional Offices covering all States and Union Territories.

grievanceRelevance.rationale: DARPG ranked UIDAI tenth with 28,802 grievance receipts from January through August 2025, and its annual report records substantial RTI activity.

sourceCompleteness.rationale: The current RTI hub links dated Head Office and Regional Office CPIO/FAA lists and appointment archives, but their complete designation and service-address contents have not yet been independently inspected.

filingAccessibility.rationale: UIDAI documents a Nodal RTI Cell for online and offline applications/appeals and publishes regional routing alongside Central online filing.

maintainability.rationale: The official RTI hub carries current dated HO/RO lists, appointment-order history and archives on a stable maintained page.

notes: Strong launch candidate pending independent inspection of the current HO/RO directory files, technical and legal/RTI approval, exact portal-label verification and privacy-safe routing fixtures. Never collect an Aadhaar number as a routing field. Quarantine the RTI hub's superseded Section 8(1)(j) text; the current India Code baseline always controls legal wording.
